_readme: Maps each Canix facility (by id) to how it should show up on the dashboard. display_name overrides Canix's own name (many are just the raw license number). stage is one of: Cultivation, Processing, Manufacturing, Distribution — left null where CCL/C11 prefixes don't make it obvious. farm_group only matters for Cultivation-stage facilities and is what the 'split by farm, with a roll-up' view groups on — pre-filled from shared street addresses, rename to your actual ranch/farm names. Set exclude:true to drop a facility (e.g. the sandbox) from the dashboard entirely.

4924._note: Checked DCC 2026-09-14: 'CCL28-0000167' (Canix's facility NAME field) returns zero results on the DCC license search — it isn't a real license number. 'CCL25-0000167' (Canix's separate license_number field for this same facility) IS real and active: Cultivation - Large Outdoor, Lake County, All Good Properties Inc — same entity as the Grange Rd license.
